answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 46237 Country: India Title: SUNNAH Question: The best ideal for men is the life and teachings of Prophet Mohammad (saw). I would like to know the authentic book which gives complete life and teachings of the Prophet (saw). Further I would also like to know some authentic books which help our daughter, wife, sister & mother to follow the lifestyles of pious women. (Kindly refer the books of Urdu language) Answer ID: 46237 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1197/299/TB=9/1434) You should study these books, they will be very useful: Seeratul Mustafa, Maariful Hadith, Bahishti Zewar, Hayatul Muslimin, Jazaul Amal, Rasoolullah (saw) ki Sunnatain. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
